mapper.sql: ID, ANALYSIS_CODE, ANALYSIS_NAME, BUDGET_YEAR, ORGANIZATION_ID, ORGANIZATION_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, ACCOUNT_NAME, TREND_TYPE, START_PERIOD, END_PERIOD, TREND_DATA, AVERAGE_VALUE, MAX_VALUE, MIN_VALUE, GROWTH_RATE, TREND_DIRECTION, TREND_STRENGTH, ANALYSIS_DESCRIPTION, FORECAST_SUGGESTION, ANALYSIS_RESULT, ANALYSIS_DIMENSION, ANALYSIS_STATUS, ANALYZED_BY, ANALYZED_TIME, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_TIME, REMARK, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DEL_FLAG
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS
ORDER BY CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN ANALYSIS_STATUS = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(GROWTH_RATE), 2), 0) AS AVG_GROWTH_RATE, NVL(ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ANALYSIS_STATUS = 'completed' THEN CASE WHEN TREND_DIRECTION = 'UP' THEN 90 WHEN TREND_DIRECTION = 'STABLE' THEN 75 ELSE 60 END END), 2), 0) AS FORECAST_ACCURACY FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0

SELECT
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || 'Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q') AS PERIOD_LABEL
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年' AS PERIOD_LABEL
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') AS PERIOD_LABEL
, NVL(ROUND(AVG(AVERAGE_VALUE), 2), 0) AS AVG_VALUE, NVL(ROUND(AVG(MAX_VALUE), 2), 0) AS MAX_VALUE, NVL(ROUND(AVG(GROWTH_RATE), 2), 0) AS GROWTH_RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS
GROUP BY
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || 'Q' || TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'Q')
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY') || '年'
TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY PERIOD_LABEL ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') AS PERIOD_LABEL, NVL(ROUND(AVG(GROWTH_RATE), 2), 0) AS GROWTH_RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY PERIOD_LABEL ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') AS PERIOD_LABEL, CASE WHEN NVL(AVG(AVERAGE_VALUE), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE NVL(ROUND((AVG(MAX_VALUE) - AVG(MIN_VALUE)) / AVG(AVERAGE_VALUE) * 100, 2), 0) END AS VOLATILITY_RATE FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY PERIOD_LABEL ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') AS PERIOD_LABEL, NVL(ROUND(AVG(GROWTH_RATE), 2), 0) AS HISTORY_VALUE, NULL AS FORECAST_VALUE FROM TBL_BUDGET_TREND_ANALYSIS WHERE DEL_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(NVL(ANALYZED_TIME, CREATE_TIME), 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY PERIOD_LABEL ASC
